detail.longDescription:
Brilliant is a visual, interactive tutor for math and coding. Our team of experts from MIT and Harvard has built a world-class personalized learning system for students from grade 5 to college and beyond.

Brilliant’s tutor Koji works through problems with you step by step. He sees where you’re stuck, sketches right on your screen, asks the right questions, and guides you to real a-ha moments. 

Forget memorizing formulas. Brilliant is designed to build understanding and help you excel. It’s there when you need it, adapts to how you think, and makes learning feel like a fun challenge instead of a chore. 

You can learn from scratch, work through homework, and prepare for tests.

Master everything from foundational math and algebra to college-level calculus, Python, computer science, AI, neural networks, algorithms, data analysis, physics, and more. 

Brilliant is trusted by over 5,000 schools and loved by over 10 million parents, students, and teachers.

WHY BRILLIANT WORKS

- A visual, interactive tutor, not a cheating machine
Learn with Koji on a shared interactive canvas for math, or in a live coding environment for programming. He asks guiding questions, sketches on your screen, and gives hints as you work.

- Start at the right level, with a plan that adapts
Koji checks what you know and builds a learning plan around your level. As you progress, regular assessments adjust the plan to cover any knowledge gaps and keep you moving forward.

- Get help on demand
Upload your homework, say what’s going to be on an upcoming test, or ask about a specific math or coding concept. Koji reviews everything, works with you on mistakes and weak spots, and gets you ready to solve problems on your own. You can also work with him toward bigger goals, like learning Python or tackling calculus.

- Build the CS skills that actually matter
AI has changed coding forever. Write and run real code, learn to read and debug code you didn’t write, and build the thinking skills programmers need now: designing programs, solving problems methodically, and reasoning about correctness, data, and cost.

- Track your progress and know what to practice next
See what you’ve mastered and what still needs work. Koji targets practice to where you need help and personalizes review sessions to optimize your learning.

WHAT YOU CAN LEARN

Math: fractions, ratios, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, contest math, and more.

Coding: Python, computer science fundamentals, algorithms, data structures, debugging, AI, neural networks, how to write and verify code with AI, and more.

TRUSTED BY FAMILIES AND SCHOOLS

- 100,000+ 5-star reviews (App Store and Google Play)
- Used in more than 5,000 schools
- Fully accredited by ACS WASC
- kidSAFE COPPA certified

WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING

“She’ll get stuck on a problem and then yell, ‘Never mind, Mom, I got it!’ How great is that?” — Arianne

“Koji explains things in detail but in a simpler way so I can really take in the material.” — Sae

“I learned the basics of calculus in 12 days. This app made me the best student in my math class.” — John

“Koji doesn’t judge. It feels like talking to the most patient teacher.” — Alan

“The best way to get into knowing the basics for understanding code.” — Chema

“Brilliant is incredible at visually representing novel ideas in order to form foundational understanding in students.” — Yegor
